messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #7243 (serve: shard-routing) is blocked on the new shard placement RFC. I linked both below. Need architecture signoff before merge; tests pass locally. @maria @sanjeev
Maria: Thanks Alex — I'll take a look first thing tomorrow. Curious if this changes the default routing policy or just introduces an opt-in flag?
Sanjeev: Reviewing now. If this touches cross-region cache invalidation we should add an ops checklist item. Will comment on the RFC in a bit.
Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/7243
Alex: RFC draft: https://docs.internal.redwood/rfcs/shard-placement (internal)
Alex: The PR adds a feature flag: `shard_aware_routing` and updates the route table codepath.
Jordan: Left 2 small review comments on unit tests and a missing null-case in the router. None blocking.
Sanjeev: High-level: +1 on the approach but one open question on KV cache TTL semantics across regions. If TTL remains per-shard we need opt-in or a migration strategy. Added a note on the RFC.
Priya: Ops chiming in — opt-in TTL per-shard is fine. We don't need infra changes but want a release note warning.
Alex: OK I'll add TTL opt-in flag and update the RFC/pr description. Plan to push changes tonight. Can I get a quick recheck after? Targeting merge EOD tomorrow if no new issues.
Maria: Sounds good. If Alex pushes the opt-in change I'll re-review and approve.
Jordan: I'll re-run the tests after the change; will approve once CI is green and the null-case test is added.
Sanjeev: After Alex updates the TTL behavior and documents the migration note on the RFC, I can give arch ok.
Alex: Pushed update: added `shard_ttl_opt_in: true` flag + test for null-case. Updated RFC section on migration.
deploy-bot: CI build passed — all checks green (build/ci 1765012880).
Maria: Reviewed the change. LGTM. Approving now.
Jordan: Approving as well. Nice cleanup on the router tests.
Sanjeev: Arch acked. Good to merge once release notes include the ops warning.
Priya: Will coordinate release notes with engdocs. No infra action required.
Alex: Merged at 1765012899 — thanks everyone :tada:
